styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, lakefront and the river architecture.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Deep dish, hot dogs and neighborhood eats.

styles.label: Art
styles.blurb: The Art Institute, murals and gallery districts.

stays.why: Central for museums, the river walk and transit; easy walk to the lakefront.
Restaurants and galleries close by; short walk to the Magnificent Mile.
Shopping and lakefront access; good for first-time visitors.
Quieter, near the zoo and park; cheaper than downtown.

food: Try deep-dish pizza once; expect a 30–45 minute bake time, so order when you sit down.
Chicago-style hot dogs: no ketchup. Cheap lunch at many stands.
Italian beef sandwiches are a local staple; ask for it 'dipped'.
Explore neighborhood restaurants in Wicker Park, Logan Square and Pilsen for better value than downtown.
Book popular dinner spots ahead; weekends fill up fast.
more_time: Swap a downtown day for the Museum of Science and Industry or a lakefront walk in Hyde Park.
Take an architecture boat tour on the river if the weather is dry.
Spend an afternoon in Pilsen for murals and Mexican food.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the museums, the lakefront and a good meal or two; add a night for neighborhoods.

month_notes: Cold: highs near 0°C, lows around -7°C. Bundle up and plan indoor sights.
Still cold, highs near 2°C. Short outdoor walks only.
Warming a little: highs near 7°C, some rain on about 12 days.
Milder: highs near 12°C, but the wettest month with rain on about 14 days.
Pleasant: highs near 19°C. Good for walking the lakefront.
Warm and lively: highs near 25°C, rain on about 12 days.
Hot: highs near 27°C, lows near 19°C. Stay hydrated outdoors.
Warm and similar to July: highs near 26°C.
Comfortable: highs near 24°C, fewer rain days.
Cool and crisp: highs near 17°C. Great for parks.
Chilly: highs near 9°C, rain on about 8 days.
Cold again: highs near 4°C, lows near -3°C. Pack a warm coat.

climate_guide.summary: Continental climate: cold winters, warm summers, and rain spread through the year.

items.title: Cold winters (Dec–Feb)
items.text: Highs near 0–4°C and lows down to -7°C. Wind off the lake makes it feel colder.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 8–14 rain days each month; April is wettest. Carry a light rain jacket.

items.title: Best months: May–September
items.text: Highs 19–27°C. Ideal for the lakefront, walking and outdoor dining.

items.title: Summer heat
items.text: July and August peak near 27°C with humid days. Plan indoor breaks at midday.

items.title: Crisp fall
items.text: September and October cool to 17–24°C with fewer rain days. Good for parks.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers year-round; a warm coat, hat and gloves for winter; a rain jacket and comfortable shoes for walking.

transit.best: CTA 'L' trains and buses for most trips; walk along the lakefront.

modes.text: CTA 'L' trains run 24 hours on some lines; fares about $2.50, $5 from O'Hare.
CTA buses cover the city; pay with Ventra card or contactless.
Taxis are plentiful but pricey in rush hour; Uber and Lyft both work.
Driving is slow and parking is costly; skip a car downtown.
Walking and Divvy bike-share are great along the lakefront.
No ferries for visitors; the lakefront path is the best route.
